posts.title: Welcome to ZERO SUS
posts.excerpt: New site, new home for my projects and writing. Here's what I'm building and where this is going.
posts.body:
This is the first post on the new **ZERO SUS** site.

I'm building modern applications, creating clean UI, and learning cyber security — and this blog is where I'll log the journey.

## What to expect

- Project breakdowns
- Things I learn while building
- Notes from the security side

> Turning ideas into reality, one post at a time.

Written and published straight from my own admin panel. More soon.
